publishers.description: The statutory body that registers companies, businesses and limited liability partnerships in Malaysia (Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia). It maintains the official company and business registry and sells registry information and corporate data.

publishers.name: Copernicus
publishers.description: The European Union's Earth observation programme, which publishes satellite and modelled environmental data — land cover, atmosphere, marine and climate reanalysis — that covers Malaysia and the surrounding region.

publishers.name: CTOS Data Systems Sdn Bhd
publishers.description: A Malaysian private credit reporting agency. It provides consumer credit reports and scores through CTOS Credit, and business and company credit reports through CTOS Business and the CTOS Basis company directory.

publishers.name: Department of Environment Malaysia
publishers.description: The federal agency responsible for environmental regulation and enforcement, including air and water quality monitoring, environmental impact assessment and scheduled waste control.

publishers.name: Department of Irrigation and Drainage
publishers.description: The federal department responsible for water resources, drainage and flood management. It operates the national network of rainfall and river-level monitoring stations.

publishers.name: Department of Statistics Malaysia
publishers.description: Malaysia's national statistical office. Produces official statistics on population, the economy, prices, labour and society, and publishes much of it openly through OpenDOSM.

publishers.name: Energy Commission Malaysia
publishers.description: The regulator for Peninsular Malaysia's electricity and gas supply industry, established by statute. Publishes reliability and performance indices for the grid.
publishers.notes: Established under the Energy Commission Act 2001, so recorded as a statutory body.

publishers.name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
publishers.description: A United Nations specialised agency that publishes FAOSTAT, a global statistical database of food and agriculture covering Malaysia across crops, livestock, land use, food security and trade.

publishers.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
publishers.description: An international network and data infrastructure that publishes open biodiversity occurrence records, including records collected within Malaysia, through a searchable portal and a REST API.

publishers.name: Global Forest Watch
publishers.description: An open forest-monitoring platform maintained by the World Resources Institute that publishes near-real-time forest change, land cover and fire data with a country dashboard for Malaysia and a public data API.

publishers.name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
publishers.description: An open platform run by the United Nations OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data that aggregates humanitarian datasets, including country-level data for Malaysia.

publishers.name: International Labour Organization
publishers.description: A United Nations specialised agency that publishes ILOSTAT, a global labour statistics database covering Malaysia across employment, unemployment, wages, hours of work and labour force participation.

publishers.name: International Monetary Fund
publishers.description: An international financial institution that publishes macroeconomic and financial statistics for its member countries, including Malaysia, through its data portal and an SDMX API.

publishers.name: International Telecommunication Union
publishers.description: A United Nations specialised agency for information and communication technologies that publishes global ICT statistics, including connectivity, mobile and broadband indicators for Malaysia.

publishers.name: Keretapi Tanah Melayu Berhad
publishers.description: Malaysia's national railway operator, running intercity, ETS, Komuter and freight services on the peninsula. Publishes timetables, route maps and station information.

publishers.name: Malaysia Biodiversity Information System
publishers.description: The national biodiversity data platform, maintained for the federal environment ministry. Brings together species records, protected areas and habitat information for Malaysia.

publishers.name: Malaysia External Trade Development Corporation
publishers.description: The national trade promotion agency. Publishes Malaysia's external trade statistics and market information for exporters and importers.

publishers.name: Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission
publishers.description: The regulator for the communications and multimedia industry, established by statute. Publishes statistics on the telecoms, broadcasting and postal sectors.
publishers.notes: Established under the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998, so recorded as a statutory body rather than a government department.

publishers.name: Malaysian Geospatial Data Infrastructure
publishers.description: Malaysia's national geospatial data infrastructure, providing a geoportal for discovering and using authoritative map and spatial data from federal agencies.

publishers.name: Malaysian Government Central Data Exchange
publishers.description: The federal government's central platform for sharing data between public agencies. Provides governed access to government datasets and services for authorised users.

publishers.name: Malaysian Investment Development Authority
publishers.description: The federal investment promotion agency. Publishes approved manufacturing and services investment statistics for Malaysia and its states.

publishers.name: Malaysian Meteorological Department
publishers.description: The federal department responsible for weather, climate and earthquake monitoring in Malaysia. Publishes forecasts, warnings, rainfall records and climate data, with an API for the weather datasets.

publishers.name: Malaysian Open Data Portal
publishers.description: The Malaysian government's central open data portal. Aggregates datasets published by federal agencies and exposes them through a searchable catalogue and a public API.

publishers.name: Malaysian Palm Oil Board
publishers.description: The federal agency responsible for the palm oil industry: research, regulation and the official industry statistics.

publishers.name: Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
publishers.description: The federal ministry responsible for domestic trade, consumer protection and cost of living. Operates PriceCatcher, the national price monitoring service.
aliases: Kementerian Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

publishers.name: Ministry of Health Malaysia
publishers.description: Malaysia's federal health ministry. Runs KKMNOW, the ministry's public data portal, where national health indicators are published as dashboards and downloadable datasets.
publishers.notes: The ministry homepage at moh.gov.my returned HTTP 403 to automated requests on 2026-10-04, so it is recorded as gated rather than broken.

publishers.name: Ministry of Transport Malaysia
publishers.description: The federal ministry responsible for land, maritime and aviation transport. Publishes transport sector reports and statistics across its modes.

publishers.name: National Property Information Centre
publishers.description: The property data centre of the Valuation and Property Services Department (JPPH), Ministry of Finance. Publishes Malaysian property market data, transaction records and price indices.
publishers.notes: NAPIC sits within JPPH, a federal department under the Ministry of Finance, so it is recorded as a government publisher rather than a statutory body.

publishers.name: OpenStreetMap
publishers.description: A community-built map of the world, published under an open licence. Malaysia is well covered for roads, buildings, places and administrative boundaries.

publishers.name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
publishers.description: An intergovernmental organisation that publishes comparable economic, social and environmental statistics through its data explorer and SDMX API. Malaysia is not an OECD member, but it appears as a partner or non-member economy in several datasets.

publishers.name: Pos Malaysia
publishers.description: The national postal operator. It maintains the authoritative postcode and addressing reference for Malaysia.

publishers.name: Prasarana Malaysia Berhad
publishers.description: The government-owned urban public transport operator for the Klang Valley and Penang, running Rapid Rail (LRT, MRT, monorail) and Rapid Bus services under the Rapid KL brand.
publishers.notes: myrapid.com.my and www.myrapid.com.my both entered a redirect loop on 2026-10-04 and could not be verified, so only prasarana.com.my endpoints are recorded.

publishers.name: RAM Holdings Berhad
publishers.description: A Malaysian credit rating agency (RAM Ratings) and risk-analytics provider. It publishes credit ratings for issuers and debt instruments, rating announcements, rating methodologies and subscription research.

publishers.name: Road Transport Department Malaysia
publishers.description: The federal department responsible for vehicle registration, driving licences and road transport enforcement. Vehicle registration data is published through the national open data portal.
publishers.notes: jpj.gov.my did not accept a connection from this network on 2026-10-04 (DNS resolves to 110.159.245.10 but the request timed out), so only the department's published datasets on data.gov.my are recorded here. The site www.jpj.my is not the department and is excluded.

publishers.name: Securities Commission Malaysia
publishers.description: Malaysia's statutory regulator of the capital market (Suruhanjaya Sekuriti Malaysia). It publishes capital-market statistics, annual and quarterly reports, consultation papers and research.

publishers.name: Sustainable Energy Development Authority Malaysia
publishers.description: The statutory authority responsible for promoting and monitoring sustainable and renewable energy in Malaysia. Publishes installed renewable energy capacity statistics.
aliases: Pihak Berkuasa Pembangunan Tenaga Lestari Malaysia
publishers.notes: Established under the Sustainable Energy Development Authority Act 2011, so recorded as a statutory body rather than a government department.

publishers.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
publishers.description: The statistical office of UNESCO, publishing global education, science, culture and communication statistics covering Malaysia, with bulk downloads and a public API.

publishers.name: United Nations
publishers.description: The United Nations Statistics Division publishes UN Data, an aggregated portal of official statistics for member states including Malaysia, and the global SDG indicators API.

publishers.name: United Nations Children's Fund
publishers.description: A United Nations agency that publishes global statistics on children and women — child mortality, nutrition, health, education and child protection — including country-level data for Malaysia.

publishers.name: United Nations Comtrade
publishers.description: The United Nations Commodity Trade Statistics Database, published by the UN Statistics Division, holding import and export records reported by Malaysia and its trading partners.

publishers.name: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
publishers.description: The United Nations refugee agency, which publishes global forced-displacement statistics — refugees, asylum-seekers, internally displaced people and stateless persons — including figures for Malaysia, with a public data API.

publishers.name: Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia
publishers.description: A Malaysian public research university (The National University of Malaysia). It operates a journal article repository and an e-journal system hosting UKM-published journals.

publishers.name: Universiti Sains Malaysia
publishers.description: A Malaysian public research university. It operates Repository@USM, an institutional repository of its research outputs and publications.

publishers.name: Universiti Utara Malaysia
publishers.description: A Malaysian public university. It operates institutional repositories covering its electronic theses and dissertations and its research and publications.

publishers.name: World Bank
publishers.description: An international financial institution that publishes a large open collection of development indicators for most countries, including Malaysia, with a documented API.

publishers.name: World Health Organization
publishers.description: A United Nations specialised agency that publishes the Global Health Observatory, a global collection of health indicators covering Malaysia across mortality, disease, immunisation, health systems and risk factors.
